profile.headline: SR Software Engineer
profile.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
•	+7 Years as a Team Leader in JAVA (8,17,21) technologies and Front-end technologies. 
•	+6 years as an Enterprise Architecture Designer. 
•	+7 Principal Software Engineer 
•	+8 years of experience as a Scrum Master.  
•	+10 Business Analyst.
•	+12 Java technologies (J2EE, SOA, REST, Spring 6, Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud, Spring batch, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Stream API, Lambda functionalities.).      
•	+5 in Angular (2,4,8,17)  using NPM and Angular Cli.
•	+4 in VUEJS 2 using NPM. 
•	+4 Docker, OpenShift, AWS USING AWS, EC2, ROUTER 53, C3, AMI, IAM.   
•	+6 years developing Services in Soap, Rest, Spring Cloud, Active MQ, Rest template and feign. 
•	+9 years of experience developing HTLM, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, PRIMENG, ANGULAR, VUEJS. 
•	+1 years using Python with  MCP connected with LLM (GPT) 
TECHNICAL SKILLS:
Continuous Planning Tools:	Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps.
Cloud:	OpenShift, Docker, AWS (EC2, ROUTER 53, C3, AMI, IAM) 
Source Control Tools:	Bitbucket, GitHub, Gitlab
Orchestration and Container Tools:	Docker, Kubernetes
Programming Languages and Tools:	JAVA, Java Script, Typescript, AWK, Shell, SQL, Spring, Spring boot, Spring Data, Spring batch, spring actuator and spring boot admin
Databases:	Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL Server, Postgres, Maria DB
Micro services:	Spring cloud (SOA, REST).
Front end:	JSF, JSP, STRUTS, HTML5, EXTJS, ANGULAR 4,8, VUEJS.
Testing:	karma, protector, Testbed, Junit, Mokito.
Reports:	JASPER, IREPORT, BIRT, POI.
Business Analysis:  	SCRUM, RUP and UML
Messaging:	Rabbit MQ, Kafka
Servers:	Tomcat, WebLogic
Continuous Monitoring Tools:	Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, Data Dog, jMeter.
Repositories:	Maven, Gradel, Npm.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Development and design of microservices using spring boot and OpenShift and thread Pool. 
•	Increase the  performance of the application using  spring actuator, spring boot admin and appDynamics. in order to check the performace of the application and implementing  the fix for the application.
•	creation of jobs in order to get information of the tables and Passing to Redis Cache in order to decrease the latency using thread Pool.
•	We are using agile methodologies in order to develop the application.
•	Junit and Mockito for the unit test. The application is validated using SonarQube, Nexus, and Fortify, Git Copilot.
Environment: Java 21,11, Spring boot, Redis, SonarQube, Nexus, Fortify, AWS, Junit, OpenShift, Mockito, Microservices, Agile.

positions.title: Sr. Technical Lead and Architect for Huawei America
positions.description:
•	Leader 25 people to take out projects like (starling Brazil, Data Market, Rpa projects). 
•	In charge of the team assignment depending on the project
•	daily monitoring of projects in order to identify risk for projects.
•	Developing standalone application and distributed application using micro services (spring cloud).
•	Deploying, managing, and operating scalable, highly available, and fault tolerant systems on AWS
•	Using technologies like Angular 10, vuejs, java, selenium, spring, shell, awk, Java 8, Stream API, lambda functionalities. Spring stream connected to (Kafka).
•	Data base like MySQL, Postgres, SQL server.
Environment: Java 8, Spring, Microservices, Spring cloud, AWS, Angular 10, Vuejs, Selenium, Shell, awk, Stream API, lambda functionalities, Kafka, MySQL, Postgres, SQL server.
